rules.rule: LPWA-50 SUCCEEDS iff all three gates pass
rules.G1_primary_AP: mean over seeds of Delta_i = AP_B(lpwa50, i) - AP_B(U50, i) at 24570 is >= +0.75 AP. The paired 95% t CI (df=4) is reported; statistical significance is NOT required.
rules.G2_mechanism: mean over seeds of Delta locR50_B (localization recall @IoU .50, arm B, Phase 12 rules) > 0. Mechanistic corroboration; no separate significance test.
rules.G3_resources: params <= 811,144 AND GFLOPs@512 < 2.707 (target <= 2.0, met at design: 1.965)

decision: STOP architecture work; no second allocation, no module search
